# Adrian Turbiński

> Front-end, Angular and full-stack developer from Wrocław, Poland, available for freelance work in Wrocław, in Lower Silesia and remotely. He has built web applications since 2019, employed and freelance, mostly in Angular, TypeScript, RxJS and Node.js. The site has two editions, one for recruiters and one for clients, each in Polish and English.

- Senior frontend developer and tech lead. At PSE Innowacje he builds an app that models and visualizes high-voltage power lines. He designs front-end and back-end architecture, has led a small team and onboards new engineers.
- As a freelancer he builds complete web apps for companies: front end, back end and deployment, usable with a keyboard and a screen reader. From the quote through deployment to maintenance, clients talk to him directly.
- Contact: adrian.turbinski@gmail.com, [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/adrian-turbi%C5%84ski-b266b21a6), [GitHub](https://github.com/adiyy2001).

## Work

- [TailorCloth](https://adrianturbinski.pl/en/archive/tailorcloth/): a website on Odoo with custom product management modules for a tailoring company from Kraków, built with the team he led at Media Hunters; another agency maintains it today
- [flagtide](https://adrianturbinski.pl/en/archive/flagtide/): a self-hosted feature flag service, a Quarkus back end that pushes changes over WebSockets and an Angular SDK on npm; live demo, source on GitHub, measured numbers
- [gridtwin](https://adrianturbinski.pl/en/archive/gridtwin/): an educational digital twin of a small transmission network, an AC power flow checked against MATPOWER, a single-line diagram and a 3D substation in Angular, a Java and Quarkus back end; live demo and source on GitHub
- [coschema](https://adrianturbinski.pl/en/archive/coschema/): a real-time collaborative diagram editor in Angular with offline editing, per-user undo and a convergence simulator; live demo and source on GitHub
- [Sample websites](https://adrianturbinski.pl/wzornik/): nine websites for made-up businesses, each with its own typeface, palette and signature element; every page says the business is made up; in Polish, Kminek and Przęsło also in English
- [Projects](https://adrianturbinski.pl/en/archive/): the index of the work above
